name: Carleton University
summary: University in Canada's capital with engineering, journalism and public affairs degrees; apply directly or via the OUAC.

ib.text: Full IB: three SL and three HL, at least 28 points; one grade of 3 is allowed if offset by a 5. Prerequisite subjects need a 4, and some degrees ask 5 or higher overall points, such as 32 for Aerospace Engineering.

dates.label: Main deadline for international students (transcripts from outside Canada and the US)
Final IB grades must reach Carleton to confirm a conditional offer

programmes.name: Engineering
programmes.about: A wide range of engineering programs, from aerospace and mechanical to software, electrical and civil, with hands-on design of aircraft, vehicles, machinery, software and medical systems, and an optional co-op.
programmes.ib: Maths (AA, or AI HL), Physics and Chemistry at HL or SL; 26 to 32 points by discipline, and a 5 in each for Aerospace and Mechanical.

needs.note: A 4 for most disciplines; a 5 for Aerospace, Biomedical and Mechanical
A 4 for most disciplines; a 5 for Aerospace, Biomedical and Mechanical
A 4 for most disciplines; a 5 for Aerospace, Biomedical and Mechanical

programmes.selectionNote: Offers are conditional on the total: 26 for most disciplines up to 32 for Aerospace and Mechanical. Overall averages are set each year and limited places mean more may be needed.

flagshipSource.title: Carleton Engineering: a Bachelor of Engineering with a comprehensive range of programs and hands-on projects

programmes.name: Journalism
programmes.about: A Bachelor of Journalism program whose storytelling skills lead into news careers and other fields, with a Health Sciences concentration option. Carleton describes it as internationally renowned and as having produced many top journalists.
programmes.ib: HL or SL English with a 4; the Health Sciences concentration adds Maths and Chemistry or Biology at 4.
programmes.selectionNote: Offers are conditional on at least 26 points and a 4 in English; the overall average required is set each year, so more may be needed.

flagshipSource.title: Bachelor of Journalism: an internationally renowned program that has produced many of Canada's top journalists

programmes.name: Public Affairs and Policy Management
programmes.about: Combines public policy with political science, economics, law and history to understand what governments do, why they do it and how policy can be improved, in the national capital.
programmes.ib: No specific subject prerequisites; at least 28 points.
programmes.selectionNote: No subject prerequisites beyond the Diploma: offers are conditional on 28 points, and the overall average required is set each year.

flagshipSource.title: Public Affairs and Policy Management (BPAPM): public policy with political science, economics, law and history

faculties.name: Faculty of Engineering and Design
faculties.line: Engineering: Maths, Physics, Chemistry, 26 to 32 points by discipline; Architecture and Industrial Design need Maths and Physics, 26.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science
faculties.line: Science degrees need Maths and two sciences with 26 points; Computer Science, Data Science and Cybersecurity need Maths and 28.

faculties.name: Sprott School of Business
faculties.line: Commerce, Accounting and International Business need English and Maths at 4 and 26 points; Entrepreneurship needs English.

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences
faculties.line: Arts needs English and 24 points; Economics adds Maths; Social Work 26 and Public Affairs 28, neither with prerequisites.

faculties.name: Faculty of Public Affairs
faculties.line: Journalism, Communication and Media, Global and International Studies and Public Affairs: 24 to 28 points, English at 4 for most.

faculties.name: Faculty of Health Sciences
faculties.line: Health Sciences needs Maths and two sciences with 28 points; Nursing needs English, Maths, Biology and Chemistry with 28.

notes: Carleton has frozen international undergraduate tuition for 2026/27, 2027/28 and 2028/29, at CAD 39,000 for Arts, 45,000 for Commerce and 55,000 for Engineering and Computer Science, plus about 2,500 in fees.
A conditional offer is based on mid-term or predicted IB results and is confirmed only if the required overall points and subject grades are met in the final results.
HL subjects graded 5 or better may earn up to 3.0 credits of advanced standing at the faculty's discretion.
